items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: We played a Friday... Sammy couldn't make it

ctx.x: When was the last time you went to, what? That Sunday we played.
When was Sunday? That was Friday. Friday, yeah. Yeah, Friday. We played a Friday. We played at two hours. And, uh... Sammy couldn't make it? Sammy couldn't make it, no. You see, he couldn't make it.
He had too much work. He had a lot of work, you know, special work.
